items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you play the soprano sax? like Stanley Bechet?

ctx.x: You know why. Because they got me to play a saxophone after they taught me all they could on -- anyway, they taught me a lot of things to play.
Did you play the soprano sax? like Stanley Bechet?
Yeah, I played. But only in a few concerts, you know. I can't understand -- I am trying to think. Buddy, can I take this down for a minute.
